newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo tender drains 59 bln skr from market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo tender drains 59 bln skr from market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, drained 59 billion crowns from the market in Tuesday morning's reverse repurchase tender.
The reverse repo was set at a fixed rate of 4.60 percent, a 25 basis point reduction from last week's tender as foreshadowed by the Riksbank last week.
It will run from October 30 to November 6, replacing an operation that drained 63 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 13.88 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
